acceptance_gate: A proves the dichotomy, the network theorem and the test of the claim, with checks that recompute transfers, full products, block systems and ring memory on Boolean and many-valued knots, network memory and free sets against the twisted-cohomology and frame-matroid predictions, and the failing systems of the counterexamples.
objective: Serves open questions 3 (composition) and 9 (space from a law) of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md. The owner asked, after CYCLE-TRACTABILITY-20261021-001, to state and test a unified claim: group-like knots are exactly the ones that both remember loops and compose like cycles, so holes behave like homology over finite fields modulo the tops; to tie it to KNOT-LOOPS-20261019-001 (only group-like knots remember a loop) and HOLES-COHOMOLOGY-20261019-001 (one H1 class per loop); and to say what it implies for contact networks. Scoping found three things. (1) A knot's transfers either have a full product, and its rings forget, or permute a partition into blocks, and its rings keep a lasting record (Protasov and Voynov's theorem on matrix families without positive products); for two-valued witnesses this is the ring theorem. (2) In a law that composes like cycles, modulo the tops every knot link is affine with a gain in a finite field, and a network of copies remembers exactly the twisted first cohomology of its graph, with the frame matroid of the gain graph as its free sets. (3) As stated, the claim holds for two values and fails beyond: the 3-nets of S3 and Z6 are group-like and remember loops but do not compose like cycles; a dressed parity knot composes like cycles without permutation transfers; twisted affine knots compose like cycles and are group-like but forget at some lengths. A proves these and the corrected claim.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. The unified claim (group-like knots are exactly those that remember loops and compose like cycles) holds for two values and fails beyond: the Z6 and S3 3-nets are group-like and remember loops but do not compose like cycles, a dressed parity knot composes like cycles without permutation transfers, and x + y + z = 0 over F3 forgets odd rings. Corrected and proved: a link remembers a loop exactly when its transfers permute blocks (Protasov and Voynov), extending the ring theorem to any number of values; in a law composing like cycles, modulo the tops every three-variable knot with a common witness range has one gain in a finite field, its networks remember exactly twisted first cohomology, their free sets form the frame matroid of the gain graph (one class per loop when untwisted), and twisted loops bind in pairs, while fixed-point binding into atoms leaves cycle-like composition. Networks alone cannot certify cycle-like composition; graphs are recognized, not created. Next (owner's choice): contact, network and distance questions (2/3), banking the composition series (2/3), or Urquhart's conjecture (1/3).
stop_rule: One bounded epic: a precise statement, a proof or counterexample, and the consequence for contact networks. If the per-knot and per-law notions cannot be aligned, close with the exact mismatch.
